- **Keep editing after generation.** Change labels, nodes, an"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"d layout in Excalidraw, with autosave in the current session.
- **Take the result with you.** Export"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" PNG/SVG for sharing or `.excalidraw` for further editing. Ask the Agent to read the canvas when you"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" want it to incorporate your manual changes."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## What it adds"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Surface | Behavior |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `diagram_create` | Creates a diagram for the current Agent Session from a compact semantic specifi"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"cation. `visualStyle: "sketchnote"` selects the optional hand-drawn compiler; controlled `icon` valu"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"es compile to editable native primitives rather than images. |
| `diagram_read` | Reads a bounded su"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"mmary of the current editable scene into the conversation transcript. |
| `canvas-diagram` skill | B"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"uilt-in bilingual routing entry: selectable from the composer's `/` menu and matched by generic diag"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ram requests, so the Agent reaches `diagram_create` without exact tool-name prompts. |
| Inline chat"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" preview | After `diagram_create`, a preview card appears in the conversation flow and always render"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"s the diagram's current content — including later canvas edits — as a static SVG. |
| **Canvas** tab"},{"id":"p21s9","text":" | Opens the Excalidraw editor only when selected, keeping it out of the normal chat startup path. |"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"

| Profile | `desktop` (managed on the Plugins page) or `web` |
| Web bind addr"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ess | `127.0.0.1` only (Desktop's own Host already uses loopback) |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0` or `>=24."},{"id":"p25s5","text":"0.0` |
| Editor | Excalidraw `0.18.1` |
| Storage | Plugin-owned DSH storage-domain sidecar |
| Inst"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"all artifact | Prebuilt npm package or GitHub Release tarball with SHA-256 checksum |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The npm package has no install lifecycle scripts. Installation adds a bundle to the selected DSH pro"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"file; it does not compile code or modify the DeepSeek Harness source tree."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Data, security, and limits"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- The Excalidraw scene is the current document. The original semantic specification is retained only"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" as its creation source.
- A diagram is bound to its Session id and `{createdAt, cwd}` lifecycle fin"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"gerprint. A reused Session id cannot read older data.
- Session fork and Session export do not copy "},{"id":"p28s4","text":"or include diagram sidecar data.
- Editor assets and fonts are self-hosted by the bundle; the canvas"},{"id":"p28s5","text":" does not depend on an external CDN.
- Static paths, RPC bodies, request origin, Session ownership, "},{"id":"p28s6","text":"and scene contents are validated by the Host before persistence.
- Images, iframes, embeddables, ext"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ernal links, and non-empty binary files are rejected in this release.
- Defaults limit each scene to"},{"id":"p28s8","text":" 1 MiB and all stored diagram records to 64 MiB. Element, text, diagram-count, and byte limits are e"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"xplicit in `cordis.patch.yml`.
- The plugin intentionally refuses to load when DSH Web binds to `0.0"},{"id":"p28s10","text":".0.0`; this release does not expose the canvas RPC to a LAN."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Desktop says "dsh-diagram@0.6.0 is incompatible with DSH 0.1.7-rc.2""},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The package manager picked an older release. If your Desktop is `0.1.7-rc.1`, update the app to `0.1.7-rc.2` first."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Why does startup fail with `0.0.0.0`?"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The canvas RPC is not designed for LAN exposure in this release. The plugin fails closed unless DSH "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"Web is physically bound to `127.0.0.1`."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### What should I do after a revision conflict?"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The editor keeps the local draft. Export it before choosing **Reload server version** if you need to"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" preserve both versions."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"### Why can SVG export log a font fallback warning?"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"Under the strict content security policy, Excalidraw may fall back from glyph subsetting to embeddin"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"g the full self-hosted font.
